subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using the parts of sentences from each column of the table below :
stimulus: (a) Good health does not mean a vital role in attaining this wealth. (b) Bulky body makes the soundness of both body and mind. (c) To be a healthy man one leads our life happy and enjoyable. (d) Food habit should have an unhappy life. (e) An unhealthy man plays good health.
guide_solution: (a) Good health makes our life happy and enjoyable. (b) Bulky body does not mean good health. (c) To be a healthy man one should have the soundness of both body and mind. (d) Food habit plays a vital role in attaining this wealth. (e) An unhealthy man leads an unhappy life.
